description: Make images and video in the Cubric Studio app on this computer.
long_description: Lets Claude drive the Cubric Studio desktop app: list and open your projects, pick a model, and generate images and video that land in your gallery. Cubric Studio must be open. Nothing leaves your computer except what the models you choose already send.
